## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
Sector Rotation / Transitional, not Risk-On or Risk-Off; Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Financials and Consumer Discretionary leading while major mega-cap techs show divergence; Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5). Major divergence among large caps (AAPL, GOOGL, TXN) — watch for trend break.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Financials lead: COF (1W: +1.62% | 1M: +20.20%) ABOVE TREND, PNC (1W: +1.45% | 1M: +17.28%) ABOVE TREND, GS (1W: -1.13% | 1M: +13.92%) TREND EXHAUSTION. Consumer Discretionary strong: TSLA (1W: +8.51% | 1M: +19.80%) ABOVE TREND, GM (1W: +1.19% | 1M: +20.63%) ABOVE TREND. Materials showing strength: FCX (1W: +2.35% | 1M: +21.90%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities weak: AEP (1W: +0.36% | 1M: -7.40%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL, DUK (1W: +1.39% | 1M: -7.66%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL, sector avg -5.58% (0/6 positive). Energy weak: OXY (1W: -6.78% | 1M: -6.10%) BELOW TREND, EOG (1W: -8.66% | 1M: -7.03%) BELOW TREND, sector avg -2.92% (2/8 positive). Communication lagging on 1M: NFLX (1W: +2.01% | 1M: -14.25%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL, TMUS (1W: +1.37% | 1M: -7.81%) RECOVERY.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: FCX (1W: +2.35% | 1M: +21.90%) ABOVE TREND; GM (1W: +1.19% | 1M: +20.63%) ABOVE TREND; COF (1W: +1.62% | 1M: +20.20%) ABOVE TREND; TSLA (1W: +8.51% | 1M: +19.80%) ABOVE TREND; EL (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +18.83%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5) — cyclical and financial strength.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ORCL (1W: -15.41% | 1M: -14.20%) BELOW TREND; NOW (1W: -8.49% | 1M: -6.54%) BELOW TREND; EOG (1W: -8.66% | 1M: -7.03%) BELOW TREND; VLO (1W: -7.49% | 1M: -8.16%) BELOW TREND; OXY (1W: -6.78% | 1M: -6.10%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in select tech and energy names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W movers: TSLA (1W: +8.51% | 1M: +19.80%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +6.10% | 1M: +3.19%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +5.95% | 1M: +5.94%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +5.04% | 1M: +5.43%) ABOVE TREND, BMY (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +15.85%) ABOVE TREND. Note MAJOR DIVERGENCE: AAPL (1W: -1.50% | 1M: +2.67%) TREND EXHAUSTION, GOOGL (1W: -4.26% | 1M: +7.63%) TREND EXHAUSTION, TXN (1W: -2.26% | 1M: +14.56%) TREND EXHAUSTION — tactical risk.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed and cautious. NVDA (1W: -3.30% | 1M: -4.75%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -0.45% | 1M: -5.95%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -15.41% | 1M: -14.20%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +9.25%) ABOVE TREND; Sector breadth estimate: 11/19 positive — Internal Rotation.

8. Financials Outlook?
Strong and consistent leadership. JPM (1W: +1.75% | 1M: +5.05%) ABOVE TREND, COF (1W: +1.62% | 1M: +20.20%) ABOVE TREND, USB (1W: -0.17% | 1M: +17.59%) TREND EXHAUSTION; Sector breadth estimate: 16/20 positive — Financials favored in the rotation.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Stable with selective strength. JNJ (1W: +1.34% | 1M: +5.54%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +1.78% | 1M: +4.97%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +6.10% | 1M: +3.19%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: -0.97% | 1M: +1.79%) TREND EXHAUSTION; Sector breadth estimate: 9/15 positive — defensive support but not dominant.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Financials and cyclicals while monitoring mega-cap tech weakness; reduce exposure to names showing confirmed BELOW TREND (NVDA, ORCL, MSFT) and watch trend-exhaustion cases for confirmation. Style: Value/Cyclical tilt but Transitional given major-cap divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: TSLA (1W: +8.51% | 1M: +19.80%) ABOVE TREND; FCX (1W: +2.35% | 1M: +21.90%) ABOVE TREND; COF (1W: +1.62% | 1M: +20.20%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ORCL (1W: -15.41% | 1M: -14.20%) BELOW TREND; NVDA (1W: -3.30% | 1M: -4.75%) BELOW TREND; EOG (1W: -8.66% | 1M: -7.03%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Financials (sector breadth est. 16/20 positive) and Consumer Discretionary (sector breadth est. 9/12 positive) on cyclical flows. BEARISH: Utilities (sector breadth est. 0/6 positive) and Energy (sector breadth est. 2/8 positive) after recent weakness.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch for confirmation of tech trend breaks vs monthly support (NVDA/MSFT/ORCL) and sustainment of financial strength (JPM/COF staying >1W positive); TSLA momentum continuation or failure will signal cyclicals' durability; any pickup in utilities relative strength would shift regime toward Risk-Off.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

Sector Rotation / Transitional with a Value/Cyclical tilt as Financials and Consumer Discretionary lead; Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. TSLA (1W: +8.51% | 1M: +19.80%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +2.35% | 1M: +21.90%) ABOVE TREND, COF (1W: +1.62% | 1M: +20.20%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: major-cap divergence (AAPL, GOOGL, TXN trend exhaustion) — watch for trend confirmation before enlarging positions.
